# ShiftKind

> ShiftKind is a job board for Washington State that connects licensed caregivers (HCA, CNA) with adult family homes that need shifts covered. Homes post shifts and live-in or live-out jobs; caregivers mark their free days and nights, keep their credentials in one place, and apply. Homes hire and pay caregivers directly.

- Caregivers never pay.
- Adult family homes start with 14 days free, then a monthly package (Standard or Plus).
- Credentials are checked by a person at ShiftKind; homes still run the state background check.
- Contact: support@getshiftkind.com, +1 (347) 567-6442
